payload.title: HealthEventsPage spec reads the wall clock: the page draws the last 14 days ending at new Date(), the fixture's mortality points are fixed at 2026-10-18/19, so the test went red on 2026-11-01 when 10-18 left the window, failing main CI and every pull request that runs farm-module tests
evidence: web/modules/farm-module/src/pages/health/HealthEventsPage.tsx:261 (each day of the 14-day series is counted back from new Date())
web/modules/farm-module/src/pages/health/__tests__/HealthEventsPage.spec.tsx:109 (the fixture's mortality points are fixed calendar dates)
web/modules/farm-module/src/pages/health/__tests__/HealthEventsPage.spec.tsx:151 (the test expects the 2026-10-18 count, which the page drops once that date is 14 days old)
payload.rule_violated: A test whose expectations depend on the current date pins the clock; its result does not change with the day it runs
payload.notes: Seen on main after cead30cf3 (run 41280339757, job test): 'Unable to find an element with the text: 412'. Independent of that merge; farm-module ran because shared-ui changed. The TasksPage spec already pins Date the same way.
